description: Google Cloud Platform enterprise cloud architecture: Cloud Run serverless microservices, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud IAM least privilege, Secret Manager, Cloud Storage, and VPC Service Controls.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Cloud Architecture

Architect highly secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and serverless workloads on Google Cloud Platform.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Adhere strictly to the Principle of Least Privilege: never assign `Editor` or `Owner` roles to automated service accounts.
- Retrieve all secrets and environment credentials dynamically through Google Secret Manager.
- Use Workload Identity Federation to bind Kubernetes service accounts to IAM roles without static keys.
- Enforce internal-only ingress on backend Cloud Run services behind an external Cloud Load Balancer.
